name: Route Mobile Limited
summary: Route Mobile Limited provides cloud-communication platform solutions to enterprises, over-the-top service providers, and mobile network operators in India and internationally. The company offers messaging, voice, e-mail, enhanced business messaging, identity and verification, bespoke solutions, and other solutions.
